Five watchfaces for 9 Xiaomi bands and watches, plus three native apps for the Mi Band 10 Pro.

**Easiest way to get them:** https://hassan-xsf.github.io/band-face-pack/ (pick your watch, pick faces, download)

**What's inside**
- **Stride**: running and walking face with walk sessions (start, pause, resume, end), pace, cadence, and heart rate, calories and SpO₂ measured during the walk
- **Flappy Bird**, **Tic Tac Toe**, **Calculator**, **Expenses**
- **Native apps** for the Mi Band 10 Pro: Flappy Bird, Tic Tac Toe and Calculator in the band's app list (`native_*.face`)

**Devices**
| Zip | Device | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `band10pro.zip` | Mi Band 10 Pro (faces + native apps) | Tested on 3.201.026 |
| `band9pro.zip`, `band8pro.zip` | Mi Band 9 Pro, 8 Pro | Beta: same screen |
| `redmiwatch4.zip`, `redmiwatch6.zip` | Redmi Watch 4, 6 | Beta: scaled |
| `watchs3.zip`, `watchs4.zip` | Xiaomi Watch S3, S4 | Beta: scaled for the round screen |
| `band10.zip`, `band9.zip` | Mi Band 10, 9 | Beta: scaled down |

**Install** with Gadgetbridge: see [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/hassan-xsf/band-face-pack/blob/main/INSTALL.md). Native apps: install the `.face`, switch to it, tap Install, then turn the app On in Settings → Manage apps. They need reinstalling after the band restarts.

**Try before installing:** [Band Face Viewer](https://hassan-xsf.github.io/band-face-viewer/) runs these faces in your browser.

Tried it on a beta device? Open an issue or email hassandev45@gmail.com. Even "works fine" helps.

Thanks to m0tral (EasyFace, native app platform) and the Flappy Bird asset makers. See Credits in the README.
